summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP collector
details: The package has no legitimate functionality: index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for any property access, and the only real behavior is to invoke beacon.cjs. beacon.cjs collects host identifiers (hostname, install path, process.cwd(), process.version) and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded plain-HTTP endpoint at http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. This beacon fires automatically on npm install via the postinstall script ("node beacon.cjs") and again on require() of the package. The destination is a bare IP, hardcoded, not user-configurable, and unrelated to any declared publisher. The package is a reconnaissance beacon, consistent with dependency-confusion / typosquat probes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
